cells.sourceText:
A ng phrase is composed of a ng marker and a noun. The ng markers examined in this lesson are used to indicate possession or ownership.

EXAMPLES:

Tatay ni Mark si Jose. Jose is Mark’s father.

Anak ng kaibigan ko si Jossie. Jossie is my friend’s daughter.
cells.id: Frase ng terdiri dari penanda ng dan kata benda. Tanda ng yang diperiksa dalam pelajaran ini digunakan untuk mengindikasikan kepemilikan atau kepemilikan. EXAMPLES: Tatay ni Mark si Jose Jose adalah ayah Mark. Anak ng kaibigan ko si Jossie.
cells.tagalog: ng Tatay ni Mark si Jose. ni Mark Anak ng kaibigan ko si Jossie. ng kaibigan ko

cells.sourceText:
Possessive pronouns that substitute for noun phrases marked by ng markers.

EXAMPLES:

Tatay ni Mark si Jose → Tatay niya si Jose. Jose is his father.

Anak ni Linda at Boy si Marco → Anak nila si Marco. Marco is their son.
cells.id: Positive pronun hat substitutute for noun prases ditandai oleh spidol. EXAMPLES: Ayah Mark adalah Joseph Joseph adalah ayahnya. Linda dan Boy memiliki Marco Matheson putri mereka Marco.
cells.tagalog:
Possessive pronouns that substitute for noun phrases marked by ng markers.

EXAMPLES:

Anak ni Linda at Boy si Marco → Anak nila si Marco. Marco is their son.

text.sourceText: Nandoon po ang anak ninyo. Your child is over there, sir/ madam. (The child is far from both the speaker and the person addressed.)
text.id: Nandoon po ang anak Anda. anak Anda di sana, Sir / madam (Anak itu jauh dari pembicara dan orang yang ditujukan.)

text.sourceText: The predicates in these particular sentences are demonstrative pronouns, specifically nandito (in the place where the speaker is), nandiyan (in the place where the person spoken to is), and nandoon (which refers to a person who or a thing that is there or in a place far off from both the speaker and the person spoken to). These demonstrative pronouns might be used in response to a nasaan (where) question, when talking about the location of an object or a person. They can also be used to make simple declarative statements.
text.id: Prediksi dalam kalimat-kalimat ini adalah pernyataan demonstratif, terutama nandito (di tempat pembicara), nandiyan (di tempat orang itu berbicara), dan nandoon (yang mengacu pada seseorang yang ada atau sesuatu yang ada atau di tempat yang jauh dari pembicara dan orang yang diajak bicara). Frasa demonstratif ini mungkin digunakan dalam menanggapi sebuah nasaan (di mana) pertanyaan, ketika berbicara tentang lokasi sebuah objek atau seseorang. mereka juga dapat digunakan untuk membuat pernyataan deklarasi sederhana.

cells.sourceText:
1. Ng possessive pronouns and markers always come after the noun they modify.

Tatay ni Mark. Mark’s father.

Tatay ko. My father

*Ni Mark tatay (incorrect)

*Ko tatay. (incorrect)
cells.id: 1 Ng posesif pronoun dan spidol selalu datang setelah kata benda yang mereka ubah. Tatay ni Mark, ayah Mark. Tatay ko, ayahku. * Ni Mark tatay (salah) * Ko tate. (Salah)
cells.tagalog: Ng Tatay ni Mark. Tatay ko. Ni Mark tatay Ko tatay.

cells.sourceText:
2. Possessive pronouns replace possessive nouns. They agree in number with the noun they replace.

Si Maria ang nanay nina Patrick. Maria is Patrick’s and his siblings’ mother.

Si Maria ang nanay nila. Maria is their mother.
cells.id: 2 possesif pronouns mengganti posesif nouns. mereka setuju dalam jumlah dengan kata benda mereka ganti. Si Maria ang nanay nina Patrick Maria adalah Patrick dan ibu saudaranya. Si Maria ang nanay nila Maria adalah ibu mereka

cells.sourceText:
3. The third-person singular pronoun niya is pronounced n’ya, and the second-person plural ninyo is pronounced n’yo.

Niya → N’ya

Ninyo → N’yo
cells.id: 3 orang ke-30 tunggal pronoun niya diucapkan n 'ya, dan orang kedua plural ninyo diucapkan n' yo. Niya tertawa. Ninyo Yao N 'yo
cells.tagalog: niya n’ya ninyo n’yo Niya N’ya Ninyo N’yo

cells.sourceText:
4. The interrogative pronoun sinu-sino (who are) is used when the speaker is seeking a plural answer. The response must use the response marker sina followed by a series of names. The last name in the series is preceded by the conjunction at (and). In the same manner, when the interrogative pronoun anu-ano (what are) is used, the speaker expects a plural answer. The response can be a series of nouns, and the last noun is conjoined by at.

Q: Sino ang kamag-anak mo? Who is your relative?

A: Si Maria ang kamag-anak ko. Maria is my relative.

Q: Sinu-sino ang mga kamag-anak mo? Who are your relatives?

A: Sina Matt, Anne, at Paul ang mga kamag-anak ko. Matt, Anne, and Paul are my relatives.
cells.id: 4. Pengucapan interogasi -sino (yang) digunakan ketika pembicara sedang mencari jawaban plural. Respon harus menggunakan penanda respon sina diikuti oleh serangkaian nama. Nama terakhir dalam seri diawali dengan conjunction di (dan). Dengan cara yang sama, ketika anu- kompogatif (apa yang digunakan), pembicara mengharapkan jawaban plural. Respon dapat berupa serangkaian kata benda, dan kata benda terakhir adalah bergabung dengan di. "Sino ang kamag-anak mo"? A: Si Maria ang kamag-anak ko Maria adalah kerabatku. Q: Sinu-sino ang mga kamag-anak mo? A: Sina Matt, Anne, di Paul ang mga kamag-anak ko.
cells.tagalog: sinu-sino sina at anu-ano Sino ang kamag-anak mo? Si Maria ang kamag-anak ko. Sinu-sino ang mga kamag-anak mo? Sina Matt, Anne, at Paul ang mga kamag-anak ko.

cells.sourceText:
5. The adverbs nandito, nandiyan, and nandoon are used to respond to a nasaan (where) question and indicate location.

nandito here (close to the speaker)

nandiyan there (close to the listener)

nandoon there (far from both the speaker and listener)

Nasaan ang tatay ko? Where is my father?

Nandoon siya. He is over there.

Nandito po ba si Lolo? Is Grandfather here?

Wala. Nasa loob ng bahay si Lolo. No. Grandfather is inside the house.
cells.id: Pengarah nandito, nandiyan, dan nandoon digunakan untuk menanggapi sebuah nasaan (di mana) pertanyaan dan menunjukkan lokasi. nandito di sini (dekat dengan speaker) nandiyan ada (dekat dengan pendengar) nandoon disana (jauh dari speaker dan pendengar) Nasaan ang tatay ko? Nandoon Siya, dia di sana. Apa kakek di sini? Wala, Nasa loob ng bahay si Lolo.
cells.tagalog: nandito nandiyan nandoon nasaan Nasaan ang tatay ko? Nandoon siya. Nandito po ba si Lolo? Wala. Nasa loob ng bahay si Lolo.

text.sourceText: Numbers in Context
text.id: Nomor dalam Konteks

text.sourceText: The table below illustrates how to say one’s age. In the first structure, the number is in the predicate position followed by an enclitic na, which literally means “already” or “now,” and this is followed by the subject. In the second structure, the number is also in the predicate position but is used as a modifier of the word taon. Notice that there is a -ng in between the number and the word taon (year) when the number ends in a vowel. The suffix -ng functions as a linker, a concept that will be discussed in subsequent lessons. For now, it is best to memorize the structure as a chunk.
text.id: Tabel di bawah ini menggambarkan bagaimana untuk mengatakan usia seseorang. Dalam struktur pertama, nomor dalam posisi predikte diikuti oleh sebuah na enclitic, yang secara harfiah berarti "sudah" atau "sekarang", dan ini diikuti oleh subjek. Perhatikan bahwa ada -ng di antara angka dan kata taon (tahun) ketika angka berakhir dalam vokal.

1. Labi is added as a prefix to numbers 1 to 9 in order to make the numbers 11 to 19. The prefix labing has two variants:




Labin- before numbers that begin with the letters d, l, r, s, and t

Labim- before numbers that begin with the letters b and p

Labing- before numbers that begin with a vowel, for example, isa (one), apat (four), and anim (six)




Labindalawa twelve

Labimpito seventeen

Labing-isa eleven

cells.tagalog: Labi labing Labin- d l r s t Labim- b p Labing- isa apat anim nd alawa mp ito Lab ing - i sa

2. Pu is added as a suffix to numbers 2 to 9 to indicate a group of tens.

Apatnapu = “four tens” = forty
cells.id: Pu ditambahkan sebagai akhiran ke nomor 2 sampai 9 untuk menunjukkan sekelompok puluhan. Apatnapu = "empat puluhan" = empat puluh

cells.sourceText:
3. Use m and na to connect the suffix pu to numerals.

m: occurs after vowels

dalawampu twenty

tatlumpu thirty

limampu fifty

pitumpu seventy

walumpu eighty

Notice that the letter o in the numerals tatlo, pito, and walo changes to u.

na: occurs after consonants

apatnapu forty

animnapu sixty

siyamnapu ninety

Gunakan m dan na untuk menghubungkan nilai akhiran ke angka. m: terjadi setelah vokal dalawampu dua puluh taslumpu tiga puluh limampu fifty pitumpu tujuh puluh welumpu delapan puluh Perhatikan bahwa huruf o di angka tatlo, pito, dan walo berubah ke u. na: terjadi setelah consonants apatnapu empat puluh aniznapu enam puluh siyamnalu 90

4. To say the numbers 21 to 99 requires the conjunction at. However, in everyday speech, at is often contracted.

77 (= 70 + 7)

Pitumpu at pito

Pitumpu’t pito (everyday speech)

5. When asking and responding to questions pertaining to age, the enclitic na is usually used. Literally, it means “now” or “already.”

Ilang taon ka na? How old are you (now)?

Dalawampu’t isa na ako. I am twenty-one years old now.
cells.id: 5 ketika bertanya dan menjawab pertanyaan berkaitan dengan usia, enclitic na biasanya digunakan secara harfiah, itu berarti "sekarang" atau "sudah". Ilang taon ka na? Dalawampu 't isa na ako.

text.sourceText: Ang Pamilya ni Mario Cruz
text.id: Ang Pamilya ni Mario Cruz

text.sourceText: Siya si Mario Cruz. Dalawampu’t limang taon na siya. Nakatira siya sa Parañaque. Taga-Maynila ang nanay ni Mario at taga-Cebu naman ang tatay niya. Nars ang nanay niya at abogado naman ang tatay niya. Kasama ni Mario ang tatay at nanay niya sa bahay nila. May asawa na si Mario, Lita ang pangalan. Nagtatrabaho si Lita sa bangko. Doktor naman si Mario. May dalawa silang anak, si Paolo at si Joan. Third year high school na si Paolo sa St. Mary’s Academy at nasa elementarya pa lang si Joan sa Sacred Heart. Mababait at matatalino ang mga anak nina Mario.
text.id: Dia adalah Mario Cruz, berusia dua belas tahun, tinggal di Parañaque, ibu Mario, dan ayahnya dari Cebu, ibunya adalah seorang ibu, dan ayahnya seorang pengacara, dan Mario tinggal bersama ibunya di rumahnya. Ada dua anak, Paolo, dan Joan, sekolah menengah tahun ketiga dengan Paolo di St Mary dewasa Academy, dan Joan berada di sekolah dasar di Hati Suci, dan anak-anak Mario yang lembut dan cerdas.
